headline: Base Ledger Marks Renewed Fighting on Several Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger shows the contest shifting rather than settling. Kuura Strand remains the liveliest ground, with four base events in the latest two hours and 18 in six, though its 35-event day is presently cooling; Faden Point and Menneen continue to dominate the record. Weathered Expanse has risen to 61 events in 24 hours, including five in the latest two, with Frostmarch, Crow’s Nest, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk foremost among the named bases. Marban Hollow has likewise recorded six recent events and 17 in six hours, led by Checkpoint Bua, while Nevish Line has added four in two hours and 12 in six. Linn Mercy’s 15 daily events are older, but its latest two-hour casualty figures have climbed sharply, leaving Outwich Ranch the principal historical marker. Pari Peak has seen four events in six hours, though none in the latest two. Elsewhere, Farranac Coast and the quieter rear sectors show little immediate movement; the front remains without a declared victor.
